{{redirect|S3|the TCG release with the set symbol S3|Darkness Ablaze (TCG)}} ''For season 3 of [[Pokémon Horizons: The Series]], see [[Pokémon Horizons: Season 3—Rising Hope]].'' {{Season Infobox |background=FFCB49 |cellcolor=DDD |name=Pokémon: The Johto Journeys |image=Season3 logo.png |caption=Logo for the season |number=3 |opening=Pokémon Johto |numeps=41 |region=[[Johto]] |series={{aniseries|GS}} |prev=Pokémon: Adventures in the Orange Islands |next=Pokémon: Johto League Champions }} '''Pokémon: The Johto Journeys''' is the third [[season]] of the [[dub]]bed version of the [[Pokémon animated series]]. It follows the second and final dubbed season of {{aniseries|OS}}, and as such is the first dubbed season of {{aniseries|GS}}. It follows the adventures of {{Ash}}, {{an|Misty}}, and {{an|Brock}} in the [[Johto]] [[region]], from [[New Bark Town]] up to [[Goldenrod City]]. It originally aired as part of the 2000-2001 {{DL|Pokémon in the United States|Kids' WB!}} Saturday morning lineup. The season began with ''[[EP106|The Pokémon Water War]]'', which originally aired on August 26, 2000, and ended with ''[[EP157|The Fortune Hunters]]'', which originally aired on May 19, 2001; it was later shortened to exclude all of the episodes until the start of ''Pokémon the Series: Gold and Silver'' with ''[[EP117|Don't Touch That 'dile]]''. It is preceded by [[S02|Pokémon: Adventures in the Orange Islands]] and succeeded by [[S04|Pokémon: Johto League Champions]]. ==Blurb== ''The Orange League beckons and Ash answers the call, taking on the Orange Crew and their leader, Drake. Upon returning to Pallet Town, Ash and Misty reunite with Brock and set out on the next stage of their Pokémon journey—the Johto region! Though he still has an errand to run for Professor Oak, Ash jumps with both feet into the Johto League, taking on a couple of Gym Leaders and adding Pokémon like Totodile and Chikorita to his team.'' ==Important events== {{spoilers}} * {{Ash}}, {{an|Misty}}, and {{an|Brock}} arrive in the [[Johto]] region, and Ash registers for the [[Johto League]]. ([[EP117]]) * Ash safely delivers the [[GS Ball]] to [[Kurt]].
